lines.text: David went to Mahanaim, where Shobi, Machir, and Barzillai met him while Absalom's army camped in Gilead.
David split his army into three groups under Joab, Abishai, and Ittai, but the people persuaded him to stay by the gate.
David ordered his commanders to treat Absalom gently, and the battle in the forest of Ephraim left twenty thousand Israelites dead.
Absalom's foot caught in an oak, and Joab thrust three spears into him before ten young men killed him.
Joab blew the ram's horn, and Absalom was cast into a pit in the Valley of Elah under stones.
